title: Integrate a newly released model
choose_when: First usable support for a new checkpoint or model architecture in an existing engine.
required_inputs: checkpoint revision and tokenizer or processor
steps: Map the model config and I/O contract to the host engine.
Run the smallest reference-parity test for each requested modality.
List missing operators or unsupported features before benchmarking.
acceptance_evidence: A reproducible load and generation smoke, parity checks and a supported-feature matrix on the named target.
